intro: Trying Times is an Alliance quest in the Wetlands where adventurers assist the dwarf Howin Kindfeather. To prepare his surly gryphon Bassbeak for an upcoming mission, Howin requires a dozen intact eggs gathered from fierce Razormaw raptors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.
They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.
Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.
Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.

clips.title: Completion
paras: They're not for me plan--they're to feed Bassbeak. She's of no help at all if she's hungry, trust me. She might be more dangerous than the orcs if she's ticked off!
Untainted food can be hard to come by in these lands as of late...
